findings.message: 4 tl.fromTo() calls target ".ch" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 1.4s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: <circle> is hidden with stroke-dasharray 1 and stroke-dashoffset 1 on pathLength 1, but its round cap can still paint a dot at the end of the path (Chrome rounds the zero-length dash differently per curve).
findings.fixHint: Make the gap longer than the path (stroke-dasharray "1 1.2" with stroke-dashoffset 1.1), or keep the element visibility:hidden until its draw tween starts.
